final_answer:
Let \(Q_n\) have generators \(x_0,\dots,x_{n-1}\) with relations

\[
3x_i-x_{i-1}-x_{i+1}=0 \qquad (\text{indices mod }n).
\]

From the recurrence \(x_{j+1}=3x_j-x_{j-1}\), every \(x_j\) is determined by \(x_0,x_1\). If \(P_0=0,P_1=1,P_{j+1}=3P_j-P_{j-1}\), then

\[
x_j=P_jx_1-P_{j-1}x_0.
\]

Here \(P_j=F_{2j}\). The two wrap-around conditions \(x_n=x_0\), \(x_{n+1}=x_1\) therefore give an equivalent \(2\times2\) presentation matrix

\[
B=
\begin{pmatrix}
-(F_{2n-2}+1)&F_{2n}\\
-F_{2n}&F_{2n+2}-1
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

So the two non-unit invariant factors are

\[
d_1=\gcd(F_{2n-2}+1,F_{2n},F_{2n+2}-1),
\qquad
d_2=\frac{|\det B|}{d_1}.
\]

Using \(F_{2n}=F_nL_n\) and the standard identity

\[
F_aL_b=F_{a+b}+(-1)^bF_{a-b},
\]

one gets

\[
d_1=
\begin{cases}
L_n,& n\text{ odd},\\
F_n,& n\text{ even}.
\end{cases}
\]

Also

\[
|\det Q_n|=|\det B|=L_{2n}-2.
\]

Since \(L_{2n}=L_n^2-2(-1)^n\), this becomes

\[
|\det Q_n|=
\begin{cases}
L_n^2,& n\text{ odd},\\
5F_n^2,& n\text{ even}.
\end{cases}
\]

Therefore

\[
d_2=
\begin{cases}
L_n,& n\text{ odd},\\
5F_n,& n\text{ even}.
\end{cases}
\]

Thus the non-unit invariant factors of \(Q_n\), in divisibility order, are

\[
\boxed{
\begin{cases}
(L_n,\ L_n),& n\text{ odd},\\[2mm]
(F_n,\ 5F_n),& n\text{ even}.
\end{cases}
}
\]
